name: SafHandle
shortDescription: Reserve a short .saf name for your Safrochain wallet — register, transfer, release and resolve handles on-chain. Phone handles land in Phase 2.
description:
SafHandle is a web dApp that turns long Safrochain addresses (addr_safro…) into short, human-readable .saf names.

With a connected Cosmos wallet (Keplr, Leap or Cosmostation) you can:
- Register a short .saf name (3–32 characters, a–z 0–9 and hyphens) — the wallet that registers becomes the owner, one name per wallet.
- Transfer a name to another wallet, or release it back to the pool.
- Resolve any name to its addr_safro… address, or reverse-lookup the name an address owns — free, read-only, no account and no fee.

An interactive demo lets you try resolution instantly, and a reserve dashboard manages your handle. Registration attaches the exact on-chain fee read from the contract config. Runs on Safrochain testnet today, with a mainnet toggle ready.

Built on the SafHandle CosmWasm registry contract and the open-source SafHandle SDK (TypeScript and Dart/Flutter). Phone-number handles — link a number to your wallet with a verifier-set verified flag — arrive in Phase 2.
statusNote: Live on Safrochain testnet (safro-testnet-1); mainnet contract pending. Name registration & resolution work today; phone handles are Phase 2.
